messages:
cass: quick poll at the watercooler: is 1.0.0.0 a semver or evidence of a time traveler? :hourglass:
toni: time traveler. also a crime against package.json. :scream:
marc: once saw 1.0.0.0-beta+exp.sha.5114f85 and the compiler filed a restraining order.
ci-bot: build failed on branch fix/normalize-versions  reason: Invalid semver: 1.0.0.0. See https://ci.redwood.example/builds/2042
cass: we need a mock courtroom: "The People vs. BadSemver". judge: YAML (indented, strictly impartial).
toni: bailiff = yamllint, prosecutor = semver-linter, defense = "it worked on my machine".
bench-bot: verdict proposed: convert 1.0.0.0 -> 1.0.0, probation: run pre-commit hooks.
marc: motion to add stickers: "I fought bad semver and all I got was this t-shirt"
ci-bot: created issue #2101 "pre-commit: semver & yaml hygiene" assigned to @infra-team.
cass: also note: if your YAML has tabs, it goes to Time-Out. :no_entry_sign:
toni: exhibit A:
```
service:
  name: rocket
	replicas: 2
```
marc: the tab vs space case goes straight to the Supreme Indenter. :laughing:
cass: ok meeting adjourned. react with :thumbsup: if you want the semver-courtroom stickers.
toni: :thumbsup:
marc: :thumbsup:
ci-bot: automated reaction: :gear:
